hyperedges.label: Live Feed Pipeline: sources to NewsStore to web via REST/SSE

nodes.label: Ink-on-Canvas Palette (#171717 on #fafafa)
nodes.rationale: Single near-black ink carries headings, CTAs and borders; near-zero chromatic chrome so the page reads like documentation.

nodes.label: Hero Mesh Gradient
nodes.rationale: Only decorative system allowed; color confined to hero so restraint elsewhere stays credible.

nodes.label: Geist Sans / Geist Mono Typography
nodes.rationale: Tight negative tracking on display; Mono reserved for code and uppercase eyebrows; binary weights 600/500/400.

nodes.label: Bimodal Button Shapes (pill vs 6px square)
nodes.rationale: Pill for marketing CTAs, 6px square for nav/app chrome; shape signals which surface the user is on.

nodes.label: Hairline-Bordered Cards
nodes.rationale: Depth via 1px hairline plus whisper shadow, never heavy elevation.

nodes.label: Component Specs (nav-bar, buttons, cards, bands, footer)
nodes.norm_label: component specs (nav-bar, buttons, cards, bands, footer)

nodes.label: Heat Score (0-100) and Rising Badge
nodes.rationale: Engagement per hour plus growth since last refresh ranks stories by how fast they are discussed.

nodes.label: 18 Interests Rotation
nodes.rationale: Each refresh reads next interests in turn so all stay current.

nodes.label: Hot vs Latest Sort
nodes.rationale: Latest shows one platform at a time so a busy platform cannot bury the rest.

nodes.label: Live Cross-Platform Search
nodes.rationale: fast=1 answers in ~1.5s with quick platforms; next page prefetched; generic words dropped before topic words.

nodes.label: Pool Cache (server/.cache/pool.json)
nodes.rationale: Saved every 2 min so restart serves feed at once.

nodes.label: Agent Reach
nodes.rationale: Install from GitHub URL; PyPI agent-reach is a different project.

nodes.label: Google News RSS
nodes.rationale: Requests spaced 2s, 2-min pause after HTTP 429.

nodes.label: Known Limits
nodes.rationale: Quora/Facebook/Instagram/TikTok/Threads excluded: block readers or need login/paid API; API local-only without auth.

nodes.label: Source References
nodes.rationale: Read code for technique only; do not copy AGPL/GPL code.

nodes.label: google-news-url-decoder
nodes.rationale: Turns news.google.com links into publisher URLs so article.ts can fetch the image.

nodes.label: Platforms Not Covered (Bluesky jetstream, Instagram, TikTok, Threads)
nodes.norm_label: platforms not covered (bluesky jetstream, instagram, tiktok, threads)

nodes.label: Do-Not-Use Repos (nitter, snscrape, pushshift, facebook-scraper, pygooglenews)
nodes.rationale: Archived or unmaintained; Pushshift closed.
nodes.norm_label: do-not-use repos (nitter, snscrape, pushshift, facebook-scraper, pygooglenews)

nodes.label: active-news-api Render Service
nodes.rationale: Free plan sleeps after 15 min; ping /api/health every 10 min; heap capped at 384MB for 512MB plan.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules (breaking changes, read node_modules/next/dist/docs)
nodes.rationale: Installed Next.js differs from training data; consult bundled docs before coding.
nodes.norm_label: next.js agent rules (breaking changes, read node_modules/next/dist/docs)

nodes.label: Active News Logo
nodes.rationale: Horizontal 520x120 brand lockup: rounded-square icon mark on the left, serif wordmark on the right.

nodes.label: Live Signal Mark
nodes.rationale: Central dot with two pairs of fading broadcast rings inside a black rounded square; signals live, real-time news broadcasting.

nodes.label: Active News Wordmark
nodes.rationale: Bold Georgia serif evokes traditional newspaper typography; 'Active' in red #ff453a emphasizes liveness, 'News' in neutral grey.

nodes.label: Orange-Red Live Gradient
nodes.rationale: Diagonal gradient #ff9a3c to #ff453a, a warm 'on-air/live' accent shared by the mark and the wordmark highlight.

nodes.label: Active News Web UI Screenshot
nodes.rationale: Dark-theme news aggregator dashboard showing what is being discussed across social platforms in one grid.

nodes.label: Header Bar (logo, search, live status)
nodes.rationale: Rounded card header with serif 'Active News' wordmark, central search input, and LIVE indicator to signal freshness.

nodes.label: Search Box ('Search what is being discussed')
nodes.rationale: Lets users query topics across all aggregated sources.
nodes.norm_label: search box ('search what is being discussed')

nodes.label: LIVE Indicator (updated Ns ago)
nodes.rationale: Red dot plus relative update time communicates auto-refreshing feed.

nodes.label: Platform Filter Chips
nodes.rationale: Pill toggles (All platforms, YouTube 313, Reddit 79, Hacker News 59, 4chan 150, X/Twitter 40, Quora 44) filter feed and show per-source item counts with green health dots.

nodes.label: 'Being Discussed' Card Grid
nodes.rationale: Three-column grid of mixed-platform post cards ranked by discussion activity.

nodes.label: Post Card
nodes.rationale: Card with platform label, colored engagement bar, thumbnail or platform-name placeholder, serif title, excerpt, and meta (author, age, views/likes).

nodes.label: Engagement / Heat Bar
nodes.rationale: Orange gradient bar at card top-right visualizes relative popularity score.

nodes.label: Platform-Name Thumbnail Placeholder
nodes.rationale: Cards lacking media show platform name in platform color instead of an image, keeping grid uniform.

nodes.label: Quora
nodes.rationale: Shown in screenshot; source may since have been removed from codebase, so screenshot may be stale.

nodes.label: Active News App Icon (Live Signal Mark)
nodes.rationale: Broadcast/live-signal glyph: central dot emitting radio waves conveys real-time news streaming; Next.js app/icon.svg convention serves it as favicon.
nodes.norm_label: active news app icon (live signal mark)

nodes.label: Orange-to-Red Gradient (#ff9a3c to #ff453a)
nodes.rationale: Warm diagonal gradient signals urgency/'live' state, applied to all signal elements.

nodes.label: Signal Core Dot
nodes.rationale: Center circle r=15 represents the news source / broadcast origin.

nodes.label: Broadcast Wave Arcs
nodes.rationale: Two pairs of symmetric arcs; outer pair at 50% opacity suggests signal fading with distance.

nodes.label: Dark Rounded Tile Background
nodes.rationale: Black app-icon squircle (rx=28) with subtle #2a2a2a border matches a dark UI theme.
